campaigns.objective: Test whether the frozen candidate material/process state produces a repeatable spatial composition-microstructure-property relationship above combined measurement uncertainty relative to a declared baseline.
freeze_before_manufacture: feedstock/powder/wire lot identifiers and certificates where available
build machine identity and maintenance/calibration state
specimen extraction map and selected orientation
intended zoning or homogeneous control locations

specimen_plan_per_build.purpose: Metallography plus local/spatial chemistry at preregistered locations.
Microhardness/local property mapping with enough valid indents to report distribution and spatial gradient.
Tensile specimens in the preregistered selected orientation when material volume permits.

requested_measurement_classes: defect/porosity characterization sufficient to bound confounding
method_anchors_to_confirm_with_lab: ASTM E8/E8M-25 or applicable current revision
ASTM E384-22 or applicable current revision
ASTM E3-26 or applicable current revision
ASTM E407-23 where etching is applicable
required_return_evidence: raw microscopy acquisition files or highest-fidelity native exports available
complete stress-strain data, not summary-only tensile values
hardness indent-level data with locations, load, dwell, rejected indents and reasons
analysis software/version and any processing scripts
uncertainty statement or laboratory measurement limitations
report linking each result to source files

requirements: candidate state analytically distinguishable from baseline/neighboring zone above combined uncertainty
effect repeats across at least three independent builds
preregistered property/microstructure endpoint follows the predicted direction or null is explicitly retained
defect and sampling/orientation effects are quantified sufficiently to prevent false attribution
blinded or recoded reanalysis/independent internal review where practical

campaigns.objective: Test whether frozen command states produce repeatable phase/amplitude response and corresponding bounded array-level field redistribution consistent with the preregistered electromagnetic model within uncertainty.

device_plan.purpose: Substrate/feed/fixture reference without active metasurface function where practical.
Resonance and unit-cell complex S-parameter response.

coupon_measurement_sequence: complex S11 and applicable S21 for each frozen state
at least three full command-state cycles
fixture reversal/rotation where practical to expose systematic asymmetry
array_test_minimum: State A reference/broadside or declared baseline pattern
State B commanded beam-steering or null state with preregistered angle/level
normalized radiation/scattering pattern over declared angular region
efficiency only where the setup supports a defensible measurement
method_anchors_to_confirm_with_lab: IEEE 149-2021 principles where antenna/radiation-pattern measurement is applicable
instrument/vendor calibration procedures for the selected VNA, fixture, band and calibration method
laboratory-confirmed near-field/far-field applicability for aperture and frequency
required_return_evidence: solver/model revision and frozen prediction digest
source power, IF bandwidth, averaging and sweep settings
raw complex Touchstone or equivalent native S-parameter files
raw pattern/scattering data for array test
report linking every derived result to raw source files

requirements: command-state phase/amplitude change exceeds combined measurement uncertainty
state ordering/sign agrees with preregistered prediction or disagreement is retained
effect repeats across power cycles and independent devices where available
measured S-parameter features correlate with frozen model within reported error
predicted beam/null reaches preregistered region within range uncertainty
thermal/fixture/cable/background controls are insufficient to explain result
raw S-parameters, pattern data, calibrations, command logs, temperature and analysis remain recoverable
